On VTES-L, Xavier Abad <Ab...@MAIL.BANCSABADELL.COM> writes:
> First of all I should say that here in Barcelona (Spain) the majority
> approve and play with the 7/7 rules.

Good to hear :-)

> Can a player play 2 "out-of-turn" masters cards between his turns?. In
> this case what happens?.

No. VTES Rulebook 3.2.1:

Once you've played an out-of-turn master card, you can't play
another one until after your next turn.

> Can a Political Seizure be played to contest a location that requires
> specific clan? (e.g. a hunting ground).

Yes.

> If the player who owned the original contested card is ousted from the
> game, what happens to the Political Seizure?.

Good question. The only ruling that can reasonably be made is that
a Methuselah yields all of her contested cards when she is ousted,
therefore the "other card" (being yielded by the ousted player) comes
into play under the control of the player who played Political
Seizure.
